question: How many employees does the company have?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee;

question: How many products are in the product catalog?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product;

question: How many customers are in the database?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM sales.customer;

question: What is the list price of the most expensive product?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT MAX(listprice) AS max_list_price FROM production.product;

question: How many sales orders were placed in 2024?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE orderdate >= '2024-01-01' AND orderdate < '2025-01-01';

question: Which department currently has the most employees?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid WHERE edh.enddate IS NULL GROUP BY d.departmentid, d.name ORDER BY employee_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product sold the most units?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(sod.orderqty) AS total_quantity FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod JOIN production.product p ON sod.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.productid, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which sales territory had the highest sum of order totals?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT st.name, SUM(soh.totaldue) AS total_due FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON soh.territoryid = st.territoryid GROUP BY st.territoryid, st.name ORDER BY total_due DESC LIMIT 1;

question: From which vendor were the most purchases made by total value, including tax and freight?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT v.name, SUM(poh.subtotal + poh.taxamt + poh.freight) AS total_due FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader poh JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON poh.vendorid = v.businessentityid GROUP BY v.businessentityid, v.name ORDER BY total_due DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which five individual (non-store) customers spent the most, based on order totals?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(soh.totaldue) AS total_spent FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.customer c ON soh.customerid = c.customerid JOIN person.person p ON c.personid = p.businessentityid WHERE c.storeid IS NULL GROUP BY c.customerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many vendors are in the database?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendor_count FROM purchasing.vendor;

question: What is the average list price of products with a list price above zero?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(listprice) AS avg_list_price FROM production.product WHERE listprice > 0;

question: How many units of products did customers order in total?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(orderqty) AS total_quantity FROM sales.salesorderdetail;

question: How many black products are there?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product WHERE color = 'Black';

question: How many female employees are there?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee WHERE gender = 'F';

question: Which products have a list price above 3000?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE listprice > 3000;

question: How many sales orders were placed online?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE onlineorderflag;

question: How many products have a sell end date set (are no longer sold)?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product WHERE sellenddate IS NOT NULL;

question: How many employees were born before 1980?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee WHERE birthdate < '1980-01-01';

question: How many products are there of each color, excluding products without a color?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT color, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product WHERE color IS NOT NULL GROUP BY color;

question: Which shipping method was used for the most sales orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sm.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN purchasing.shipmethod sm ON soh.shipmethodid = sm.shipmethodid GROUP BY sm.shipmethodid, sm.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many sales orders came from each sales territory?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT st.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON soh.territoryid = st.territoryid GROUP BY st.territoryid, st.name;

question: Which credit card type was used for the most sales orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT cc.cardtype, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.creditcard cc ON soh.creditcardid = cc.creditcardid GROUP BY cc.cardtype ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many products belong to each product category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT pc.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.productcategoryid, pc.name;

question: How many employees currently work in each shift?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh JOIN humanresources.shift s ON edh.shiftid = s.shiftid WHERE edh.enddate IS NULL GROUP BY s.shiftid, s.name;

question: Which product category sold the most units?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT pc.name, SUM(sod.orderqty) AS total_quantity FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod JOIN production.product p ON sod.productid = p.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.productcategoryid, pc.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product category generated the most revenue, where revenue is unit price times quantity times (1 - discount)?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT pc.name, SUM(sod.unitprice * sod.orderqty * (1 - sod.unitpricediscount)) AS revenue FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod JOIN production.product p ON sod.productid = p.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.productcategoryid, pc.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which salesperson handled the most sales orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN person.person p ON soh.salespersonid = p.businessentityid GROUP BY soh.salespersonid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many sales orders came from the Canada sales territory?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON soh.territoryid = st.territoryid WHERE st.name = 'Canada';

question: Which state or province has the most individual customers, based on their addresses?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid) AS customer_count FROM sales.customer c JOIN person.businessentityaddress bea ON c.personid = bea.businessentityid JOIN person.address a ON bea.addressid = a.addressid JOIN person.stateprovince sp ON a.stateprovinceid = sp.stateprovinceid WHERE c.storeid IS NULL GROUP BY sp.stateprovinceid, sp.name ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which vendor supplies the most different products?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT v.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM purchasing.productvendor pv JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON pv.businessentityid = v.businessentityid GROUP BY v.businessentityid, v.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many employees currently work in departments of the Manufacturing group?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid WHERE edh.enddate IS NULL AND d.groupname = 'Manufacturing';

question: Which employee placed the most purchase orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader poh JOIN person.person p ON poh.employeeid = p.businessentityid GROUP BY poh.employeeid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: On which date was the first sales order placed?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT MIN(orderdate) AS first_order FROM sales.salesorderheader;

question: In which month (year and month) were the most sales orders placed?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', orderdate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: On average, how many days passed between placing and shipping a sales order?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (shipdate - orderdate)) / 86400.0) AS avg_days FROM sales.salesorderheader;

question: How many employees were hired in 2010?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee WHERE hiredate >= '2010-01-01' AND hiredate < '2011-01-01';

question: In which year was the sum of sales order totals the highest?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orderdate) AS year, SUM(totaldue) AS total_due FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY year ORDER BY total_due DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which five products sold the most units?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(sod.orderqty) AS total_quantity FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod JOIN production.product p ON sod.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.productid, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which three sales territories had the most sales orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT st.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON soh.territoryid = st.territoryid GROUP BY st.territoryid, st.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: List the product categories in alphabetical order.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name FROM production.productcategory ORDER BY name;

question: Which five employees have worked at the company the longest, based on hire date?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname FROM humanresources.employee e JOIN person.person p ON e.businessentityid = p.businessentityid ORDER BY e.hiredate LIMIT 5;

question: Which ten sales orders had the highest order total?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT salesorderid, totaldue FROM sales.salesorderheader ORDER BY totaldue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many products have never been ordered by customers?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod WHERE sod.productid = p.productid);

question: How many products have a list price above the average list price of all products?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product WHERE listprice > (SELECT AVG(listprice) FROM production.product);

question: Which salespeople have year-to-date sales above the average of all salespeople?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname FROM sales.salesperson sp JOIN person.person p ON sp.businessentityid = p.businessentityid WHERE sp.salesytd > (SELECT AVG(salesytd) FROM sales.salesperson);

question: How many customers placed more orders than average, compared with the average of customers who placed orders?
ground_truth_sql: WITH orders_per_customer AS (SELECT customerid, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY customerid) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM orders_per_customer WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM orders_per_customer);

question: How many employees have a most recent hourly pay rate above 50?
ground_truth_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT businessentityid, rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY businessentityid ORDER BY ratechangedate DESC) AS rn FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory) SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND rate > 50;

question: How many employees have more vacation hours than average?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee WHERE vacationhours > (SELECT AVG(vacationhours) FROM humanresources.employee);

question: Which product categories have revenue above the average category revenue, where revenue is unit price times quantity times (1 - discount)?
ground_truth_sql: WITH category_revenue AS (SELECT pc.name, SUM(sod.unitprice * sod.orderqty * (1 - sod.unitpricediscount)) AS revenue FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod JOIN production.product p ON sod.productid = p.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.productcategoryid, pc.name) SELECT name FROM category_revenue WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM category_revenue);
